threat_event: Ransomware encrypts shared virtualization, the SCSP, and subsidiary systems at the same time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One directory and one virtualization layer serve every subsidiary; identity recovery weaknesses (R-002, R-018); acquisition gaps (R-007)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 to SYS-04; DC-1 and DC-2; all tier-1 processes (P05)
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on 97% of endpoints; PAM; immutable backups; annual tier-1 DR tests; cyber insurance
treatment_plan: Verified identity proofing at the service desk (POAM-001); directory tiering (POAM-005); AQ integration (POAM-003); ERP RTO fix (POAM-010); enterprise exercise with the disclosure committee (POAM-011)
key_risk_indicator: EDR coverage; tier-1 restore test results; privileged accounts on phishing-resistant MFA

threat_event: Attacker social-engineers the outsourced service desk into resetting MFA for a GBS identity administrator and takes over the group identity platform
threat_source: Cybercriminal group using help desk impersonation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Knowledge-based verification only; 38% of privileged accounts without phishing-resistant MFA (P07 IA-5, IA-2(1))
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 and every system that trusts single sign-on
existing_controls: Manager callback for privileged resets during business hours; SOC alert on MFA method changes
treatment_plan: Verified identity proofing for every reset (POAM-001); phishing-resistant MFA for all privileged accounts (POAM-002); contract standard for the provider (POAM-012)
owner: Director of Identity and Access Management
key_risk_indicator: Resets performed without verified proofing; privileged accounts on phishing-resistant MFA

threat_event: A vendor payment is redirected after a fraudulent bank-detail change at a Home Services branch
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Branch payables verify bank-detail changes inconsistently; 37 branch users can change bank details and release payments (P07 AC-5)
affected_asset_or_process: Home Services branch payables; ERP vendor master
existing_controls: GBS callback standard; bank positive pay; dual approval in the payment hub
treatment_plan: Move branch payables into GBS accounts payable and remove the conflicts (POAM-007); payment-fraud training for branch staff (POAM-019)
key_risk_indicator: Vendor bank changes without a documented callback; SoD conflicts open

threat_event: A compromised treasury user releases a fraudulent wire through the payment hub

treatment_plan: Payee allow-lists and anomaly rules at the primary bank
key_risk_indicator: Wires released to new payees within 24 hours of setup

threat_event: Theft of Finance customer information (about 520,000 consumers) from the loan platform, data warehouse, or file shares

treatment_plan: Data minimization and retention enforcement (POAM-022); egress analytics on the warehouse
key_risk_indicator: Customer records outside the servicing platform; large outbound transfers investigated

threat_event: Theft of payroll and HR data (SSNs, bank accounts) for 12,000 employees

treatment_plan: Label and restrict HR sites (POAM-024)
